articles.title: High-Speed Social Media Stunt Turns Fatal in Hyderabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic accident was reported in Hyderabad's Narsingi area after two youths riding a KTM bike at high speed crashed into a road divider while allegedly filming a video for social media. The rider died on the spot, while the pillion rider suffered minor injuries.

body.html:
A tragic accident was reported in Hyderabad's Narsingi area after two youths riding a KTM bike at high speed crashed into a road divider while allegedly filming a video for social media.

The rider died on the spot, while the pillion rider suffered minor injuries. Initial reports suggest they were attempting to record viral content when the crash occurred.

#Hyderabad #RoadAccident #Narsingi #RoadSafety #ViralVideo

articles.title: CCTV Shows 7-Year-Old Moments Before Disappearance; Accused Claims Boy Was 'Obstacle'
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A CCTV clip from Uttar Pradesh's Meerut has surfaced in connection with the alleged abduction and murder of seven-year-old Angadveer, capturing the child moments before he disappeared.

body.html:
A CCTV clip from Uttar Pradesh's Meerut has surfaced in connection with the alleged abduction and murder of seven-year-old Angadveer, capturing the child moments before he disappeared.

The footage, recorded in a narrow residential lane in Ramraj town under the Bahsuma police station limits, shows a car slowly moving through the locality. According to police, Angadveer was playing outside his home when someone inside the vehicle called him over. Investigators said the child appeared to recognise the occupant and was later seen getting into the car.

While the CCTV footage does not clearly capture the alleged abduction, it shows the vehicle passing through the area around the time the boy went missing and became a crucial lead in the investigation.

The child's family later filed a missing complaint and named Arpit Sharma, a resident of Meerapur, following which police launched an extensive search operation and formed multiple teams to trace the boy.

According to police, preliminary evidence led to Sharma's detention, during which he allegedly confessed to the crime. Investigators claimed the accused revealed that he had a relationship with the child's mother and considered Angadveer an obstacle to their future together.

Police further alleged that Sharma took the child away from his home and threw him into a canal. Search operations involving divers and multiple police teams were launched to recover the boy's body.

Authorities said the investigation is ongoing and further legal action will be taken based on the evidence collected.

#Meerut #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #CCTV #BreakingNews

articles.title: Popular Reel Star Prem Bhati Killed in Tragic Bike Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Popular social media content creator and reel star Prem Bhati was killed in a tragic road accident in Kalyan during the early hours of Saturday, leaving his fans and the local community in shock. According to preliminary information, the accident took place at around 3 a.m.

body.html:
Popular social media content creator and reel star Prem Bhati was killed in a tragic road accident in Kalyan during the early hours of Saturday, leaving his fans and the local community in shock.

According to preliminary information, the accident took place at around 3 a.m. when Bhati was returning home on his motorcycle from the Mohane area. His bike reportedly skidded after hitting loose gravel scattered on the road, causing him to lose control.

Bhati sustained severe head injuries in the crash and was rushed to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

The incident has sparked criticism over the condition of roads in the area, with local leaders alleging negligence in road maintenance. Shivaji Patil, President of the Rickshaw Union, questioned the role of civic authorities and contractors responsible for road repair work.

"Loose gravel left unattended on the road has become a serious hazard for commuters. Innocent lives are being lost due to negligence and lack of accountability. Strict action must be taken against those responsible," Patil said.

Police are yet to issue an official statement on the cause of the accident. However, initial reports indicate that the motorcycle lost traction after skidding on the gravel-strewn stretch.

Prem Bhati had built a strong digital presence through his comedy and horror-themed content, earning popularity among young audiences. He had more than 83,000 followers on Instagram and over 3 million subscribers on YouTube, making him one of the well-known regional digital creators.

News of his sudden demise spread rapidly across social media, triggering an outpouring of grief from fans and fellow creators. Hundreds of condolence messages flooded his accounts, with followers sharing clips from his popular videos and remembering him as an entertainer who brought joy to millions.

The tragic incident has once again raised concerns over road safety, infrastructure maintenance and the dangers posed by poorly managed construction and repair work on public roads.

#PremBhati #RoadAccident #Kalyan #BreakingNews #RoadSafety

articles.title: Out-of-Control Truck Triggers Multi-Vehicle Crash on Bengaluru Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major road accident involving multiple vehicles was reported near Lakshmipura Gate on National Highway 648 in Devanahalli taluk of Bengaluru Rural district. The incident, captured on highway CCTV cameras, narrowly avoided turning into a much bigger tragedy.

body.html:
A major road accident involving multiple vehicles was reported near Lakshmipura Gate on National Highway 648 in Devanahalli taluk of Bengaluru Rural district. The incident, captured on highway CCTV cameras, narrowly avoided turning into a much bigger tragedy.

According to available information, the accident occurred on the Doddaballapur-Devanahalli stretch of NH-648 when a truck travelling towards Devanahalli allegedly went out of the driver's control, triggering a chain collision.

The truck first rammed into a tractor moving ahead on the same road. Following the impact, it veered onto the opposite side of the highway and continued moving uncontrollably.

Moments later, the truck crashed into a Bolero vehicle approaching from the opposite direction, creating panic among motorists. Several other vehicles travelling on the busy highway escaped the collision by a narrow margin.

CCTV footage from the highway captured the frightening sequence of events, showing how quickly the accident unfolded and how close several road users came to being involved in the crash.

Despite the severity of the collision, the drivers of the truck, tractor and Bolero survived. All three sustained injuries but escaped without any life-threatening consequences.

The accident took place within the limits of the Vishwanathapura Police Station. Authorities are expected to investigate the circumstances surrounding the crash, including the alleged negligence that led to the truck driver losing control of the vehicle.

#Bengaluru #RoadAccident #NH648 #Devanahalli #Karnataka

articles.title: Woman Walks Into Police Station Wearing Iron Chain, Husband Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking case from Madhya Pradesh's Rajgarh district, a woman allegedly escaped nearly 24 hours of illegal confinement by breaking an iron lock with a stone and walking to a police station with the chain still hanging around her neck.

body.html:
In a shocking case from Madhya Pradesh's Rajgarh district, a woman allegedly escaped nearly 24 hours of illegal confinement by breaking an iron lock with a stone and walking to a police station with the chain still hanging around her neck.

The victim, Mangibai Tanwar, alleged that her husband, Sardar Singh Tanwar, tied her to a pillar with an iron chain, branded her body with a red-hot iron rod and repeatedly assaulted her after returning home drunk on the evening of June 10.

According to her complaint, the violence began after dinner when her husband allegedly abused her. When she objected, he reportedly cut a tree branch, turned it into a stick and beat her, slapped her repeatedly and threatened her.

Unable to endure the assault, Mangibai tried to reach Khilchipur police station during the night. However, she alleged that her husband intercepted her near a temple, assaulted her again and forcibly took her back home.

She further claimed that he wrapped an iron chain around her neck, locked the other end to a pillar and challenged her to go to the police.

Mangibai alleged that her husband then heated an iron rod on a gas stove and pressed it against her waist, hip and right thigh, causing severe burn injuries. She remained confined inside the house for nearly 24 hours and was allegedly prevented from speaking to anyone.

According to the complaint, the accused was also trying to gather villagers for a panchayat to pressure her into dropping any plan to approach the police. Fearing further violence, she pretended to agree while waiting for an opportunity to escape.

The chance came when her husband left the house to call villagers. Alone, she picked up a stone and repeatedly struck the lock securing the chain until it finally broke.

She then walked through isolated roads, fields and rough terrain towards Khilchipur police station with the broken chain and lock still around her neck. Thorns pierced her feet, leaving scratches and bleeding injuries, but she continued her journey. Many people assumed she was mentally unwell after seeing the chain, while one passer-by offered her food before she resumed walking.

When Mangibai reached the police station at around 10 pm on Friday, officers were shocked to find the iron chain still locked around her neck and visible burn marks on her body. She broke down while narrating the alleged ordeal.

Police removed the chain and sent her for a medical examination, which reportedly confirmed multiple injury marks and burn wounds. A police team was immediately dispatched to the village, and the accused husband was arrested.

Khilchipur Station House Officer Kamal Singh Gehlot said a case has been registered under relevant sections based on the woman's complaint of assault and illegal confinement. The accused has been arrested and produced before the court.

Police said the incident stemmed from a domestic dispute that escalated into severe violence, and further investigation is underway.

#MadhyaPradesh #Rajgarh #CrimeNews #WomenSafety #BreakingNews

articles.title: Ranger Caught in Hotel? Wife's Surprise Visit Triggers Dramatic Confrontation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Forest Range Officer (Ranger) posted in the Baraunda Circle of Madhya Pradesh's Satna district was allegedly found with a young woman at a hotel in Rewa after his wife, a police constable, confronted him, leading to a dramatic altercation that spilled onto the streets.

body.html:
A Forest Range Officer (Ranger) posted in the Baraunda Circle of Madhya Pradesh's Satna district was allegedly found with a young woman at a hotel in Rewa after his wife, a police constable, confronted him, leading to a dramatic altercation that spilled onto the streets.

According to reports, the officer has been identified as Brijendra Pandey, while his wife is posted as a constable at Baraunda Police Station in Satna district.

The incident reportedly took place at Hotel Royal Inn in Rewa after the wife received information that her husband was staying there. She went to the hotel and reached his room, where she allegedly asked him whether anyone else was present.

Although the Ranger reportedly denied that anyone else was inside, the wife entered the room and allegedly found a young woman there.

The discovery led to a heated argument inside the hotel premises. According to eyewitnesses, the wife brought the young woman outside and questioned her about her relationship with the officer, attracting a large crowd.

Several bystanders recorded videos of the confrontation, which later went viral on social media.

Eyewitnesses claimed that as the dispute intensified, the Ranger and the young woman left the hotel, boarded a dumper vehicle and drove away, while the wife continued protesting at the spot.

Following the incident, an FIR was registered against Ranger Brijendra Pandey and the young woman at Chorhata Police Station in Rewa. However, police have not yet disclosed the sections under which the case has been registered or details of the complaint.

According to sources, the constable had travelled to Rewa without obtaining official leave. Police are currently investigating the incident based on the viral videos and the complaint.

No official statement has been issued by either party so far, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Driver Fills ₹4,290 Fuel and Speeds Away Without Paying in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A car driver allegedly fled without paying after filling petrol worth ₹4,290 at a fuel station in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur district on Sunday night. The incident took place at Rudra Shiv Filling Station in Para village under the Birno police station limits.

body.html:
A car driver allegedly fled without paying after filling petrol worth ₹4,290 at a fuel station in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur district on Sunday night.

The incident took place at Rudra Shiv Filling Station in Para village under the Birno police station limits.

According to pump owner Nizamuddin Siddiqui, the driver got his car filled with petrol while salesman Nazil prepared the bill. However, before the payment could be collected, the driver allegedly started the vehicle and sped away.

Salesman Nazil reportedly attempted to stop the car and chased it for some distance, but the accused managed to escape.

Following the incident, a complaint was lodged at Birno Police Station.

Police have launched an investigation and are examining CCTV footage from the petrol pump to identify the vehicle and trace the accused driver.

The incident has raised concerns among local petrol pump operators, who are demanding stricter measures to prevent such incidents and ensure the safety of fuel station staff.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Air Force Personnel’s Wife Alleges R##e, Blackmail and Forced Religious Conversion; Two Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case has emerged from Nagpur, where the wife of an Air Force personnel has accused a former classmate and his associates of r##e, blackmail, extortion, black magic and forced religious conversion.

body.html:
A shocking case has emerged from Nagpur, where the wife of an Air Force personnel has accused a former classmate and his associates of r##e, blackmail, extortion, black magic and forced religious conversion.

Police have arrested the main accused, Ayaaz Madare, and his associate, Ameen Shaikh, while a police team has been sent to Madhya Pradesh to trace a maulana allegedly involved in the alleged conversion.

According to the FIR, the 24-year-old woman alleged that on February 8, 2025, Ayaaz invited her to a hotel, where he allegedly spiked her drink. When she regained consciousness, he had allegedly recorded objectionable photographs and videos of her.

The woman alleged that the accused then blackmailed her by threatening to send the videos to her husband and circulate them on social media. She further claimed that she was repeatedly sexually assaulted and extorted of around ₹4 lakh.

A viral video has emerged as a key piece of evidence in the case. The footage purportedly shows the woman crying and pleading, saying "Chhodo Mujhe" ("Let me go"), while Ayaaz allegedly holds her hands, chants religious verses and repeatedly blows over her. The woman alleges that she was subsequently declared "converted" and that an attempt was made to r##e her thereafter.

In her complaint, the woman further alleged that Ayaaz frequently forced her to consume a liquid from a plastic bottle, after which he would mutter words in Urdu, blow on her face and claim it was "hypnosis and black magic" before sexually assaulting her.

The FIR also states that on May 31, Ayaaz and his associate allegedly took the woman to Kalmeshwar, where a third accused, identified as a maulana from Tamia village in Madhya Pradesh's Chhindwara district, allegedly conducted religious rituals and forced her to say "qubool hai" against her will.

According to the complaint, the maulana then declared that she had converted to Islam and that her nikah with Ayaaz had been performed. The woman further alleged that she was forced to eat meat, recite the kalma and was later taken to a hotel where Ayaaz allegedly r##ed her again. She also claimed that the accused continued visiting her residence and sexually assaulting her.

Police have registered a case under relevant sections pertaining to r##e, repeated sexual assault, extortion, blackmail, forced religious conversion and provisions of the anti-black magic law.

Deputy Commissioner of Police Suresh Reddy said electronic devices seized during the investigation are being sent for forensic analysis and will play a crucial role in the probe.

"A police team has gone to another state to search for the maulana allegedly involved in the conversion. A thorough investigation is underway," the officer said.

The allegations made in the FIR are under investigation, and police are continuing to probe all aspects of the case.

#Nagpur #Maharashtra #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Gonda Policemen Allegedly Thrash Youths with Sticks Inside Outpost, Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video allegedly showing two young men being beaten by policemen at the Dubaha police outpost under Kaudiya Bazaar police station limits in Uttar Pradesh's Gonda district has surfaced on social media, prompting an official inquiry.

body.html:
A video allegedly showing two young men being beaten by policemen at the Dubaha police outpost under Kaudiya Bazaar police station limits in Uttar Pradesh's Gonda district has surfaced on social media, prompting an official inquiry.

The viral footage reportedly shows a constable striking a young man with a stick while a Home Guard holds him. Moments later, another youth is brought forward and allegedly beaten in a similar manner in the presence of the outpost in-charge. The video is said to be from May 22.

According to reports, the incident is linked to a complaint filed on May 22 by Sanjay Kumar, a resident of Chainapur village, who accused Ramesh, Rameshwar, Arvind, Parag, Dimple and Phalhad of assaulting him and his wife, Sunita.

Following the registration of the case, the Kaudiya police directed the Dubaha outpost to take action. Acting on the instructions of the outpost in-charge, Constable Neeraj Singh allegedly detained the accused persons from Chainapur village and brought them to the outpost.

After reaching the outpost, Arvind, Ramesh and Mahesh reportedly claimed that they too had been assaulted and sought a hearing.

According to the allegations, police personnel then instructed Home Guard Anurodh Tiwari to restrain Ramesh while Recruit Constable Aman, a 2025 batch constable, allegedly beat him repeatedly with a stick. The youths were allegedly assaulted one after another before being issued challans for breach of peace on May 23.

Victim Arvind alleged that he and his brothers were taken into custody and assaulted inside the outpost despite informing police that they had also been attacked during the dispute.

"We were beaten inside the police outpost in the presence of the station in-charge and later challaned the next day," he claimed.

Kaudiya police station in-charge Jitendra Kumar acknowledged that assaulting anyone in such a manner is unacceptable and said strict action would be taken against those found guilty.

An investigation has been ordered into the incident, and further inquiry is underway.

#Gonda #UttarPradesh #PoliceBrutality #ViralVideo #BreakingNews

articles.title: Bengaluru Man Allegedly Strangles Woman After Family Fixes Her Engagement
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 33-year-old man allegedly strangled his secret wife to death after learning that her parents were arranging her engagement with another man in Bengaluru's Byadarahalli police station limits.

body.html:
A 33-year-old man allegedly strangled his secret wife to death after learning that her parents were arranging her engagement with another man in Bengaluru's Byadarahalli police station limits.

The accused allegedly attempted to stage the incident as a mutual s**** by c***ming poison after the murder.

The deceased has been identified as Bhavani S, a resident of Tulasi Nagar and a native of Magadi in Bengaluru South district. She worked as a billing executive at a mobile phone shop in Tigalarapalya.

The accused, Chandrashekar, is an autorickshaw driver.

According to police, the incident came to light on Saturday morning when Bhavani's aunt informed her mother that Bhavani had posted an Instagram story featuring a man. Concerned, her father, Srinivasa N, called her at around 7.30 am but received no response despite repeated attempts.

He then contacted the house owner and requested him to check on her. The house owner noticed signs that someone was inside the house but received no response after repeatedly knocking on the door, following which he alerted the police.

Police reached the spot and found Bhavani dead inside the house, while Chandrashekar was found unconscious but alive. He was shifted to a nearby hospital for treatment and later taken into police custody.

Investigators said there was a strong smell of a poisonous substance inside the house, which was also detected on both Bhavani and Chandrashekar.

During the investigation, police discovered that the couple had secretly married a year ago and had been living together without their families' knowledge.

However, Bhavani had recently learned that Chandrashekar was already married and had a six-year-old child. Distressed by the revelation, she informed her family, who subsequently arranged her engagement to another man, which was scheduled for the following week.

Police said Chandrashekar visited Bhavani's house on Saturday and an argument broke out between them. He allegedly told her, "I cannot live without you. We should either live together or die together."

Investigators further alleged that Chandrashekar uploaded a photograph of their marriage on Instagram. After Bhavani's family saw the post and contacted her, another confrontation reportedly took place between the couple.

During the altercation, Chandrashekar allegedly strangled Bhavani to death before consuming poison in an apparent attempt to stage the incident as a mutual s****.

Police have registered a case and are continuing their investigation into the incident.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #CrimeNews #BreakingNews
